Then use the quadratic formula: x = (-b ± √(b² - 4ac)) / (2a). Calculate the discriminant to see if there are real solutions. If it’s positive, two real roots; if zero, one; if negative, no real roots. This is the most reliable method, though it can feel mechanical.

To find stationary points, take the derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. These x-values are candidates for maxima or minima.
